title: Foundation, Museum, Company, or School?
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: Foundation, museum, company, and school are different stewardship architectures; none can simultaneously maximize control, access, interpretation, teaching, commerce, and permanence.
The record separates the material dress, House of Worth attribution, Charles Frederick Worth design credit, accession, and the museum’s present custody.

01 · PURPOSE — What must continue?. Separate object care, digital preservation, research, public access, teaching, grants, commercial licensing, authentication, publication, and correction into explicit functions.
